# Nebuloid Tech Studio

> Nebuloid Tech Studio LLP is a Gurugram-based creative technology studio specializing in AI photo booths, digital experiences, interactive kiosks, event technology, experiential marketing, and brand activations for corporate events across India.

## Primary offerings
- AI Photo Booth / AI Photo Booth India / AI Photo Booth for Events
- Digital Experiences and interactive visitor journeys
- Interactive kiosks and touchscreen software
- Event branding, registration systems, and venue technology
- Experiential marketing and brand activations
- Corporate event technology ecosystems
